app.name: Blink Chat
standalone.profile.setup: Add a provider and its API key under Providers & models to start chatting. Nothing is sent anywhere until you do.
standalone.models.help: Connect any OpenAI-compatible service. Type model IDs exactly as your provider names them; Blink does not verify them against a vendor catalog.
standalone.models.defaultsHelp: Defaults apply to new chats and the image tool. Chats you already started keep the provider and model they were created with.
standalone.models.name: Provider name
standalone.models.nameRequired: Enter a provider name before saving.
standalone.models.keySaved: A key is saved on this device. It is never shown here; type a new one to replace it.
standalone.models.keyMissing: No key saved yet. Paste the key your provider gave you.
standalone.models.refreshHint: Refresh imports the model list from the saved provider. Save your edits first; it is disabled while the form has unsaved changes.
standalone.models.extraChat: Additional chat model IDs (one per line)
standalone.models.extraImage: Additional image model IDs (one per line)
standalone.models.endpointHint: The full URL is used exactly as typed; it is never rebuilt from the base URL.
standalone.models.noModels: No models match. Add model IDs in the provider editor.
standalone.models.deleteBody: New chats and the image tool will default to another saved provider. Past chats stay saved; if one used this provider, choose a different provider and model before continuing it. Only this provider's saved key is removed.
standalone.models.deleteLastHelp: Keep at least one provider. Add another before deleting this one.
standalone.models.discardBody: This provider has unsaved edits, including any key you typed. Leaving discards them.
standalone.personalization.help: These instructions are global: they are sent to the model before every reply, in every chat and with every provider.
standalone.personalization.label: System prompt
standalone.files.help: Notes are plain text files in this app’s private storage on this device. With tools on, the model can read and write them.
standalone.files.name: File name
standalone.files.empty: No notes yet. Create one above.
standalone.files.discardBody: This note has edits that are not saved. Continuing replaces them.
standalone.agents.help: Blink Chat ships with three built-in tools. There is nothing to install and no agent marketplace.
standalone.skills.help: Skills are the built-in tools below. This release has no downloadable plugins or skill packs.
standalone.tools.help: With tools off the model only writes text: no clock, no notes, no images.
standalone.tools.clockHint: Reads the current date and time on this device.
standalone.tools.notesHint: Reads and writes the notes in Files. They stay on this device.
standalone.tools.imageHint: Draws a new image with the default image model from Providers & models.
standalone.queue.body: Queued and scheduled sends are not in this release. Each message goes straight to the model and the reply streams into the chat.
standalone.updates.body: This build does not check for or install updates. Get new versions from the same place you installed this app.
standalone.notifications.body: Background notifications are not in this release. Replies arrive while the chat is open.
standalone.scope: In this release: text chat, photo understanding and image generation. Voice input and video come later.
standalone.unavailable: This action is not available in Blink Chat yet.
standalone.failed: That did not work. Try again.
standalone.tool.limit: Reached the tool step limit for one reply. Ask again to continue.
standalone.tools.disabled: Built-in tools are off. Turn them on under Tools to use the clock, notes and image generation.
standalone.error.auth: The provider rejected the API key. Check it under Providers & models and save it again.
standalone.error.rate: The provider is rate limiting this key. Wait a moment and send again.
standalone.error.provider: The provider could not complete this request. Try again shortly.
standalone.error.response: The provider sent a reply this app could not read. Try again or choose another model.
standalone.error.network: Could not reach the provider. Check your connection and the base URL; your draft is kept.
standalone.error.settings: These settings are incomplete. Check the base URL, the model names and the image endpoint.
standalone.error.storage: Could not save on this device. Free some space and try again.
standalone.error.path: That file name is not allowed. Use a simple name such as notes.md.
standalone.error.image: The image could not be generated or read. Try again or choose another image model.
standalone.error.limit: This request is too large for the model. Shorten the message or remove an attachment.
standalone.error.key: Add an API key to a provider under Providers & models before sending.
standalone.error.tool: A built-in tool could not finish. The reply above is kept; try again.
standalone.error.busy: A reply is still running. Stop it or wait before starting another.
standalone.providers.last: Keep at least one provider. Add another provider before removing this one.
standalone.providers.missing: This conversation’s provider was removed. Choose a model from a saved provider to continue.
